title: Try the reviewers in order and skip unusable providers
spec:
A profile already lists its reviewers in order (`Profile.reviewers`, a tuple of model ids), but only the first is ever used. A reviewer error (network, missing key, unparseable verdict) should move to the next reviewer without costing the worker a level.

1. conductor/reviewer.py: `review(profile, model, spec, diff, post=None)` takes the reviewer model as its second positional argument and uses it (its provider, its API model id, its options) instead of `profile.reviewers[0]`.
2. conductor/escalation.py:
   - `Judge` becomes `Callable[[str, str, str], Verdict]`, called as `judge(reviewer_model, spec, diff)`.
   - Add `NO_CHANGES = Verdict(False, "no changes produced", "")` and `NO_REVIEWER = "every reviewer provider is excluded for this run"`.
   - Add `review_entry(model, verdict) -> dict` with keys `model`, `ok`, `reason`, `raw`, `usage`, `error` (`asdict(verdict.error)` or None) and `cost` (`verdict.cost`); use it for every review record. `attempt_entry` gets `"review_fallbacks": []`.
   - When the diff is not empty, consult the reviewers in order: skip a reviewer whose provider (`provider_of`) is in `self.state.excluded_reviewer_providers`; the first verdict without an error decides; a verdict whose error kind is `PROVIDER_UNUSABLE` adds that provider to `excluded_reviewer_providers` (never to the worker exclusions). The last consulted reviewer goes in `entry["review"]`, the earlier failed ones in `entry["review_fallbacks"]` (in order), and `entry["cost"]["reviewer"]` is the deciding verdict's cost.
   - If every consulted reviewer failed, the step is `needs_brain_review` with the last verdict's reason as detail. If no reviewer could be consulted (all excluded), it is `needs_brain_review` with detail `NO_REVIEWER`, no judge call, and `entry["review"]` stays None.
   - An empty diff is still rejected without calling any reviewer, recorded as `review_entry(self.profile.reviewers[0], NO_CHANGES)`.
3. conductor/cli.py: the `judge` closure takes `(model, spec, diff)` and calls `reviewer.review(profile, model, spec, diff)`.

Update the existing tests to the new signatures and add tests: an unparseable verdict moves to the next reviewer within the same attempt (the worker is not re-run) and is recorded in review_fallbacks with its cost; an unusable reviewer provider is skipped for the rest of the run and does not touch worker exclusions; all reviewers failing hands the diff to the brain; all providers excluded hands it to the brain without a judge call; review() uses the reviewer it is given (URL and model id of that reviewer's provider).
